pages.title: Solar panel efficiency in 2024
pages.html:
Solar panel efficiency in 2024

Commercial monocrystalline solar panels typically convert between 20 and 23 percent of sunlight into electricity.

The record for a single-junction silicon cell is about 26.8 percent.
